decisions.reason: The charting bundle is a cheap add-on to the established map.apps platform that still meets aspirations, but it has not been visible since 2018, so there is some risk it was folded into the core release or quietly retired.
The hierarchical search bundle costs little to maintain in a growing industry with slack, but its minor visibility and absence from the website since 2018 make dropping it a real possibility.
VueTOC looks like an experimental mobile component that has disappeared from view, and redirecting its resources to the core platform is the likely outcome of search after weak signals of uptake.
As the flagship platform line defining the firm's strategic direction, it stays regardless of short-term visibility.
Mobile field data capture serves core customer processes in utilities and the public sector and shows no clear shortfall against aspirations, so it is kept despite limited recent visibility.
The search extension is a low-cost complement to the web map apps that slack can carry, although its fading visibility raises the chance that it gets merged into other products or retired.
